title: Towards a universal meta-optics solver via large language models
abstract: arXiv:2608.26417v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Metasurface design increasingly requires fast models that can operate across structurally distinct device families, rather than retraining a separate surrogate for every geometry class. Conventional neural network surrogates often depend on fixed-dimensional descriptors, family-specific output formats, and repeated architecture tuning, which limits their scalability across heterogeneous meta-atoms. Here, we present a unified large language model (LLM) workflow for multi-family metasurface modeling and inverse-design. Geometries, design parameters, and optical response channels were converted into a shared instruction-following text format and used to fine-tune Gemma-2-9B across 8 metasurface families. Compared with single-family baselines, the joint model simultaneously predicted the optical responses of all metasurface families while reducing the MSE for each family by an average of 56.5%. translated_title: 面向通用超构光学求解器：基于大型语言模型的方法
translated_abstract: 超表面设计日益需要能够跨结构不同器件族快速运行的模型，而不是为每个几何类别重新训练单独的代理模型。传统神经网络代理通常依赖固定维度描述符、特定族的输出格式以及反复的架构调整，这限制了它们在异构超原子间的可扩展性。在此，我们提出一种统一的大型语言模型工作流，用于多族超表面建模和逆向设计。几何形状、设计参数和光学响应通道被转换为共享的指令跟随文本格式，并用于在8个超表面族上微调Gemma-2-9B模型。与单族基线相比，联合模型同时预测所有超表面族的光学响应，同时每个族的均方误差平均降低56.5%。相同的表示也用于逆向设计。
tldr: 本文提出一种基于大型语言模型的统一工作流，通过共享文本表示同时建模多个超表面族，实现了跨族预测性能的显著提升（均方误差平均降低56.5%）。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a unified large language model workflow that simultaneously models multiple metasurface families via a shared text representation, achieving significant cross-family prediction improvements (average 56.5% MSE reduction).
